name: copy-path-with-lines
description: Copies the active file's full path with the selected line range, or adds it straight into a coding agent's context.

commands.title: Add Path With Line Selection to Agent
Copy Path With Line Selection: Choose Destination

copyPathWithLines.allowMultipleSelection.markdownDescription: When multiple selections exist (e.g. from multiple cursors), merge the line ranges of all selections into the copied path (e.g. `foo.ts:11-22,34-46`). When disabled, only the primary selection is used.

copyPathWithLines.revealOnSend.description: Reveal the agent's view before adding to its context
copyPathWithLines.revealOnSend.markdownDescription: Before adding to an agent's context, run that agent's `revealCommand` to open and focus its view. Disable to leave the sidebar untouched.

copyPathWithLines.agents.description: Agents that can receive the path with line selection
copyPathWithLines.agents.markdownDescription: Agent extensions that `copyPathWithLines.sendToAgent` and `copyPathWithLines.pickAction` can target. Each entry names a command contributed by that extension; an agent whose extension is missing, or whose command is no longer registered, is reported as unavailable instead of silently doing nothing. Bind the commands yourself in `keybindings.json` (see the README).

id.description: Stable identifier, used to remember the last agent you sent to

label.description: Name shown in the destination picker

extensionId.description: Publisher-qualified extension id, checked to tell 'not installed' from 'command renamed'

command.description: Command that adds the current editor selection to the agent's context

revealCommand.description: Command that opens and focuses the agent's view
revealCommand.markdownDescription: Command that opens and focuses the agent's view. Usually unnecessary: both default agents reveal themselves as part of adding to context. Set it only for an agent that does not.

perRangeInvocation.description: Invoke the command once per merged line range
perRangeInvocation.markdownDescription: Agent commands read only the primary selection, so multiple cursors would collapse to one range. When enabled, each merged range is selected in turn and the command invoked for each, so every range reaches the agent.
